title: Kei authorize request v1
description: The kei.authorize-request/v1 request sent to the tenant-local kei-proxy daemon. Optional tool_args and tool_context are accepted only for local validation of registered connector tool plans; they never leave the tenant runtime or enter audit. No provider payloads, results or credentials are carried. The optional caller object records who called, for the audit trail; a request without it is valid and its caller is unknown.

tool_args.description: Arguments validated against the registered connector tool plan by the local runtime only.

tool_context.description: Harness-provided context validated against the registered connector tool plan by the local runtime only.

shell_command.description: Accepted only over the tenant-local socket, used solely to evaluate shell: policies, and never copied to audit.

caller.description: Optional caller metadata. Every field is optional and closed: nothing else may be added.

harness.description: Harness kind label, for example openwebui.

origin.description: interactive: a person in a live session. automation: an unattended run.

session_ref.description: Opaque session or chat reference chosen by the sender. A pointer only; it must never carry message content.
